focus_fire.clock: First observed health decrease to first observed health <= 0, by UUID.
focus_fire.inclusion: Mean/median require a full-health observation before first damage and no observation gaps.
focus_fire.censoring: Alive at episode end and disappearance are incomplete, not kills. Initially injured or observation-gap records remain separate. One-tick lethal damage has duration zero.
focus_fire.focus: Consecutive single-target health-loss events, with the previous damaged target still alive and at least two live zombies before the next event. Multi-target events break the chain.
focus_fire.note: Client-observed health changes at 0.05-second resolution, not server hit timestamps or player-attributed per-target attacks. Sweeps/environmental damage can affect health. Completed-only kill time is subject to survivor selection; inspect incomplete cases and damage-target switches too. All arena entities are diagnostic only, including outside policy FOV.

definitions.note: Angles target the nearest policy-visible zombie torso, not an exact crosshair/hitbox raycast. Range 4 is a diagnostic band, not a claim about attack reach. Damage is player-attributed statistic change; timing may lag attacks. Unanswered retreat windows are evidence consistent with kiting, not proof of intent or invulnerability.
